status.intro: Live status for LicenseMeter and the infrastructure it runs on. Our own services are probed directly; the providers below report their own health, refreshed about once a minute.
status.microsoftNote: Microsoft 365 and Entra ID have no public machine-readable feed, so their status is a direct link. The full subprocessor list lives on the <trustCenterLink>Trust Center</trustCenterLink>.
status.footerNote: This page runs inside the LicenseMeter application, so it cannot report a full platform outage on its own. For incidents, watch the provider feeds above or contact support.
